name: Leeds Beckett University

programs.title: Business, Law and Social Studies
programs.summary: This International Foundation Year subject pathway will prepare to study an undergraduate degree in areas such as business, law and marketing.

programs.title: Health Sciences
programs.summary:
This International Foundation Year subject pathway will prepare to study an undergraduate degree in areas such as Biomedical Science, Dietetics and many others.

programs.title: Science, Engineering and Computing
programs.summary: This International Foundation Year subject pathway will prepare you to study an undergraduate degree in areas such as civil engineering and computing.

programs.title: Business Management
programs.summary: This International Year One route will prepare you to progress to the second year of a degree in areas such as business, human resources and economics.

programs.title: Computer Science and Cyber Security
programs.summary: This International Year One route will prepare you to progress to the second year of a degree in areas such as cyber security and computer science.

programs.title: Hospitality and Tourism
programs.summary: This International Year One route will prepare you to progress to the second year of a degree in areas such as hospitality business management and international tourism.

programs.title: Sport and Exercise Science
programs.summary: This International Year One route will prepare you to progress to the second year of a degree in areas such as sport performance and exercise nutrition.

description: Leeds is located in Yorkshire, in the north of England. It is nearby to other cities such as Manchester, Sheffield and York – as well as beautiful countryside. It is a vibrant and lively city with something for everyone; from arts, sports and leisure to entertainment and nightlife.
